options.text: The object weighs zero on the Moon

questions.text: A car travels on a highway, and its odometer records a reading of 180 km at 8:00 am and 240 km at 9:30 am. Based on this information, which statement best describes the car's average speed during this interval?

options.text: The car's average speed is 40 km per hour as calculated from the odometer readings and time interval.
The car's average speed is 240 km per hour since that was the odometer reading at 9:30 am.
The car's average speed is 180 km per hour since that was the odometer reading at 8:00 am.
The car's average speed is 60 km per hour based only on the change in odometer readings.

questions.key_answer: The car's average speed is 40 km per hour as calculated from the odometer readings and time interval.

E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed.
